title: stackfoundry guards (.stackfoundry/guards.json)
description: Read by the plugin's PreToolUse hook (`stackfoundry guard`). Written by init and configure-guards. The hook fails open: no file or an unreadable file means no opinion.

generated.description: Files that must never be hand-edited. An Edit/Write of a match is denied with the regenerate hint.

regenerate.description: How to regenerate instead, shown to Claude in the denial.

commands.description: Shell commands to deny or ask about (direct database writes, raw service launches, deploys).

pattern.description: Python regex searched in the command line.

reason.description: Shown to Claude; say what to do instead.

writes.description: What happens to git and gh writes (commit, push, reset, tag, pr create…).
